purpose: F12 of the second independent review: server.maxRequestsPerSocket = 1 does not count an HTTP/1.0 request nor Node's own answer to a request without Host or with an unknown Expect header, so a valid mutation (cancel, start, reconcile) pipelined behind ANY refusal still APPLIES while the client only sees the refusal. Raw-socket matrix against a server in a separate process, in HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/1.0 framing, with controls proving the mutation alone applies.
